meta.name: create-skill
meta.description: Guide for creating effective skills. Use when asked to create a new skill (or update an existing skill) that extends Claude's capabilities with specialized knowledge, workflows, or tool integrations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 创建或更新扩展 Claude 能力的技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要为 Claude 创建或更新自定义技能
copy.tagline_en: Create or update skills to extend Claude's capabilities
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create or update custom skills for Claude

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按照给定的步骤创建或更新技能，包括理解需求、规划资源、初始化目录、编写说明文件等。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 创建一个新技能或更新现有技能，以扩展其专业知识、工作流程或工具集成时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个 PDF 编辑技能。
say.note: Claude 会引导你明确功能并生成技能文件。

say.text: 更新我的 BigQuery 技能，添加销售数据表。
say.note: Claude 会修改现有技能目录和参考文件。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude follows a step-by-step process to create or update skills: understand requirements, plan reusable resources, initialize the skill directory, and write the SKILL.md file.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to create a new skill or update an existing one to extend its capabilities with specialized knowledge, workflows, or tool integrations.

say_en.text: Create a PDF editing skill for me.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through defining features and generating the skill files.

say_en.text: Update my BigQuery skill to add sales data tables.
say_en.note: Claude will modify the existing skill directory and reference files.
